observations.result: Inspected rendered Atlassian Toggle default/off/on examples and Geist Toggle default/off/on/disabled examples. Rounded tracks, circular thumbs and position changes informed Geul's shared implementation. No reference palette or vendor API was adopted.

Ocean light/ko and Ocean dark/en show distinct off/on and disabled states. Compact tracks measure 36×20px, thumbs 16×16px, selected translation 16px, targets 28px high and disabled track opacity 0.5. Space toggles the native checked state; Tab moves to the next enabled Switch and exposes the focus ring. Disabled switches remain disabled. Coarse-pointer minimum is source-defined, not physically tested.

Content-height and chrome choices share the first line; Footer wraps with its own heading. Groups are content-width (108.25px / 111.61px), 30px including the border. ArrowRight changes Content to Viewport without changing chrome/footer. Pointer selection changes Footer independently. Final screenshot was recaptured after the last build.
All three groups share one line. Korean tablet tops match at86.59px. English Ocean dark desktop tops match at86.59px, widths140.58px/109.05px/109.05px; final screenshot captured after the last build.

Both actual editor Views expose the same three compact layout groups and a Korean language-name trigger. Post source menu preserves 한국어 (원문); selecting English changes the trigger to English, swaps the locale body and disables source-owned options. Page groups share top440.88px. Page screenshot is an additional proof asset at design/storybook/previews/editor-chrome/page-settings-ko.png.
